subject: ARCH: dispatch and arena copies of NT1 have diverged in flag delivery, undocumented
description: Found by Nancy 2026-09-09. The two copies of nt1-network-troubleshoot/config.js are byte-identical in _checkConnectivity, the commands table and the filesystem/terminal blocks, but differ architecturally in how the flag reaches the page: dispatch fetches on demand with async engine.requestFlagText(); arena pre-caches into _scenarioFlags via BoxEngine.requestFlagText() plus synchronous BoxEngine.getDeliveredFlag() and {{FLAG:x}} token substitution resolved by Terminal._appendOutput. Roughly 100 diff lines, all of it this plumbing. Neither approach is documented as canonical and a maintainer editing one copy will not know the other behaves differently. Decide which is the intended pattern, document it, and check whether other duplicated dispatch/arena boxes have the same split.
